title: A pig grunting, grumbling and falling asleep (France, Limousin)
author: felix.blume
description: A pig grunting, grumbling and falling asleep. Close recording of a pig, in a french farm in Limousin. The pig is calles "Aphrodite" and is an old sow who won't finish into a plate! Sound recorded by a MS setup Schoeps Microphone CCM41+CCM8 Sound Devices 552 mixer + Sound Devices 744T recorder MS is encoded in STEREO Left-Right recorded in may 2012 Sound Reference: @BEL120524T33 The same sound is available on soundcloud: http://soundcloud.com/felixblume/cochon more sounds on http://www.felixblume.com Please rate the sound or comment it if you like it !
